name: yantraflow
description: Free n8n-style automation platform: link preview to Telegram, SEED-based AI auto-posting (Telegram, Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn), schedules (every N / daily at HH:MM), 23 ready-made projects and a drag-and-drop editor. Runs in the browser or 24x7 on your PC / Android (Termux).
author: Nirbhay Sharma (NISHU) — https://github.com/shanir01
